report_discrepancies.note: The supplementary proprietary funds statement (pp30-31) prints ending net position 1,241,153 (beginning 1,242,840, charges 524,993, expenses 480,365), while the basic modified-cash proprietary statement (p8) prints ending 1,226,777 (beginning 1,242,071). notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental beginning/ending_cash are the total governmental fund balances (2,245,911 -> 1,802,824, p5; no fund liabilities). Statement lines split using the fund schedules' printed breakdowns: Property and motor vehicle 162,587 (General Department p15: property 129,997, motor vehicle 17,914, NPPD 5% 14,676); Intergovernmental 681,721 (pp15, 17, 18, 21, to separate homestead, property tax credit and pro-rate); Charges for services 25,637 (pp18-20, 24); Other receipts 1,355,257 (pp15, 17, 19-21, 23-25, 28; includes CDA state grant 316,808 and Community Center donations 584,320). Statement General government 2,074,004 includes the Community Center (heading Culture and Recreation - public building, 1,806,452) minus police 500; Public Health and Safety includes fire, police and cemetery. Business-type uses the basic modified cash proprietary statement (p8, net position incl. capital assets and loans; no transfers in 2024). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Total column (p1), since it includes capital assets and notes payable. Detail: General Fund department schedules (pp15-20; the department combining schedule pp13-14 not recorded to avoid double counting), Street, Sales Tax, Cemetery, CDBG, CDA and Forestry fund schedules (ARPA had no activity; nonmajor combining p27 not recorded), and the Water, Sewer and Sanitation fund statements (pp33-35; the combined proprietary statement pp30-31 not recorded). The all-funds budget comparison (pp11-12) is not recorded (individual schedules are more detailed). Read pages 1-35 of 35
